findings: [28] Comma between the double subject and its verb, with singular «поглотило» (poglotilo, 'absorbed'): «Желание ... и невозможность изменить своим убеждениям, поглотило» (Zhelanie ... i nevozmozhnost' izmenit' svoim ubezhdeniyam, poglotilo, 'The desire ... and the impossibility of betraying his convictions, absorbed'); translated as a normal plural sentence.

[29] The opening quotation mark of «Заснуть бы, — подумал он, — чтобы не ослабеть потом. (Zasnut' by, 'I should sleep') is never closed, so the following narration and the inner quotations stand inside it; kept unclosed as printed.
[44] «созывался сбор» (sozyvalsya sbor, 'a gathering was convened'), where the finished chapter X has «собор» (sobor, 'assembly'); possibly a slip for «собор»; translated as printed ('a gathering').
[124] «с озабоченым видом» (s ozabochenym vidom, 'with a preoccupied air'): one-letter slip for «озабоченным» (ozabochennym); translated in the evident sense.
